maria: heads-up — after the runtime change rolled at 03:12 UTC (batching heuristics tweak @kevin) we see a ~9–12ms bump in 99p for small-batch fused-flash requests on canary. baseline p99 ~18ms -> now ~30ms.
kevin: ugh. can you drop the profiler snippet and canary dashboard link?
maria: copying quick profiler output (from canary region 3) — only the hot slice:
```
kernel_selector.debug: input_tokens=128, seq_len=64, batch_size=4
chosen_kernel=flash_fused_v2  p50=4.1ms  p99=29.8ms
fallback=flash_paged_v1     p50=5.0ms  p99=17.2ms
kv_cache_hit_rate=0.67  avg_kv_latency=0.4ms
batch_coalescer_delay_ms=5  (new heuristic)
```
maria: link: https://perf.redwood/canary/region3/attn/1734 (quick glance)
perf-bot: bisect-suggest: likely regression introduced at commit abc1234 (runtime: dynamic-coalesce heuristics) — delta +10.2ms p99 on fused path vs previous commit.
kevin: running local bisect now. initial hunch: the coalescer wait makes small batches prefer fused path more often, but fused has extra memcpy when kv_cache not hot. toggling flag `prefer_fused_for_small_batches=false`
alex: confirm — when kv_cache hit rate < ~0.8 fused_fused_v2 does an extra reorder+memcpy for packing keys that hurts tail. paged path streams kv lookups and avoids the big memcpy spike.
sophia: can we try revert on canary: set prefer_fused_for_small_batches=false and/or reduce batch_coalescer_delay_ms to 1ms? also add kernel_choice tag to traces so we can roll up stats by kernel.
jamal: rolled canary with prefer_fused_for_small_batches=false at 04:08 UTC. 30-min window after roll: p99 back to ~18.6ms, p50 stable. kv_hit_rate unchanged. preliminary stats: 99p delta -11.4ms.
kevin: opening quick PR to gate the heuristic behind a runtime rule: `if kv_hit_rate > 0.8 && batch_size >= 8 -> prefer_fused` else prefer paged. adding perf test in ci/perf/attn_small_batch.yaml
maria: sgtm. also add observability: kernel_choice, kv_hit_rate, coalescer_delay to spans/traces. add a regression alert for p99 increase > 5ms on canary. :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks — will push PR + perf numbers in the PR description. keeping this thread to sync infra+runtime folks.
